reason: I already run Square on an iPad and it works. Switching means retraining my techs, moving my clients, and buying a $299 reader, and I do not have time to do that on a maybe.
objection: What happens when the internet goes down on a busy Saturday? They say it keeps working, but I have heard that before from reps. I want to see it with my own eyes before I trust a new system with my cash and my card sales.
would_change_my_mind: Another salon owner I know, Vietnamese like me, who has used it for months and tells me it never lost a ticket when the internet went down. Or a free trial where they set it up next to Square so I can try it for a few Saturdays without risk.
